sourceConfirmed: Module owns its own double precision rotation solver, not NPointSolver.
CalibRot uses first three samples only for its fixed 4x2 least-squares fit; all samples contribute error, divided by full count.
Angles are float-subtracted, converted with original constant pi=3.1415926; inversion determinant threshold is double(float(1e-7)).
World transform uses top-left 2x2 only; ignores translation and projective terms. World center transformed back by 2x2 inverse.
Module samples one first array element per run. WorldRotateAngle is step angle multiplied by sample index. RotNum3..16.
Both signs are fitted. RevOutputFlag false picks smaller world error; true picks larger; both choose negative-angle candidate on exact tie.
Intermediate success outputs zero centers/errors, complete output clears sampling vectors; remaining/count follow native replay.
Refresh nonzero reloads file without clearing samples. Missing input resets sampling, writes ModuStatus0 and returns original getter code; other failure paths can publish no status.
